`Change-Id: Iac993248a60c82a202c32e5cf437df53695fdc15`, commit as `RebarBotNava
<joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com>`, DCO signed, `rebar-ticket:` trailer present.

NOT submitted and this ticket is NOT closed — awaiting `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`, and the
operator verifies the votes and submits. CI is saturated (queue was ~40min against a ~23min run),
so this will sit queued; that is backlog, not failure.

## `make verify` result and its one wrinkle

`make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=6` reported **9 failed, 19436 passed, 74 skipped in 54m29s**. Eight of
the nine were `GateCongestedError: gate admission refused: all 4 concurrent gate slots busy`; the
ninth (`test_plan_review_cli_retry::test_cli_retry_is_compatible_with_no_sign`, `assert 11 == 2`)
is the same cause surfacing as a retry count.

**Root-caused, not retried.** `gate_admission._slot_dir()` is the PER-HOST snapshot store's
`locks/` with a cap of 4, and those tests exercise the real admission context manager — so they
compete with LIVE gate runs on the same box. `ps` at the time showed an unrelated session running
`rebar review-plan verminous-zealous-krill` (pids 24863/25001). Two live gates plus `-n 6` workers
exceeded the cap, so the refusals were the cap working correctly and the tests failing to isolate.

A/B on the same host, same selection:

| sources | result |
|---|---|
| `origin/main` (`e510c64dbcb6`), change reverted in place | 20 passed |
| this change | 20 passed |
| remaining 4 previously-failing modules, this change | 51 passed |

All nine pass on this change once slots are free, and the reverted tree fails the same way when
they are not — so the change is not implicated. Filed as `dubious-neutral-duck`
(`bc3e-7f43-2195-4301`), linked `discovered_from` this story: gate-admission tests need their own
slot namespace, because a `make verify` verdict that flips on whether another session is running a
gate is not the local CI contract it is meant to be.

Everything else in `make verify` was green: `make lint` 0, `make typecheck` 0 (763 files),
complexity ratchet `new=0 increased=0`, mechanism ratchet `new=0 increased=0`.

## Module sizes (cap 800)

`lock.py` 541 (was 522 — docstring only), `lock_kernel.py` 163 (new), `lock_owner.py` 513,
`doctor_locks.py` 466. No split needed.
